title: The Mighty 18 & Pals
tagline: A fantasy story about the 18 sponsoring companies of ETHGlobal Taipei as superheroes
description: Our story is a fantasy story about the 18 sponsoring companies attending ETHGlobal Taipei Hackathon. Each company represents a different superhero with unique superpowers. The setting is Ethereum, a world where the superheroes are based in. Ethereum is not owned by anyone, but there is a villain that tries to own everything of the land. The superheroes try to save the Ethereum world and stop the villain from doing terrible things.
how_its_made:
My sister and I interviewed every sponsoring company and asked 3 questions. 1) What is your company's superpower and why. 2) What is your company's superpower in one word. 3) What are your company's goals for 2025. 

Based on the one word superpower, we utilized ChatGPT and my sister's artistic capabilities to come up with an image of each of the 18 companies.
